ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, contrasted against a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous white field. Dark pigmentation is concentrated in a thick band along the trailing edge, with discrete dark circular clusters localized in the upper-right quadrant and lower-left quadrant of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) spanning the entire boundary from tip to notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch, terminating in heavily textured, blunt tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) are present on the distal right lobe and proximal left lobe; faint yellowish-tan circular impressions are scattered across the central white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, unaligned linear marks are visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization is visible on both distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge, creating a prominent three-dimensional textured profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized patches of brownish-orange discoloration, consistent with diatom film or bio-fouling, are visible near the right tip and lower central region.
